slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: questions
slots.about: in order: id (1..n), ask, hint (may be empty), options (2 to 5 records: key A..E, text)

slots.name: answers
slots.about: saved answers: id, date, q, key; empty at first

slots.name: of_word
slots.about: joins the two counts, with spaces

slots.name: answered_word
slots.about: after the counts, with a leading space

slots.name: next_label
slots.about: saves the choice and moves on

slots.name: done_label
slots.about: the same button on the last question

asking.shows: one question, its lettered options, skip and next

nothing_picked.shows: next at low opacity; a tap does nothing

finished.shows: a tick, the closing line and a button to start over

labels.opt: letter, option words, and picked_word when chosen

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, snappy and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the chosen option carries a tick and picked_word in its label
